record.question: Erythropoiesis is stimulated by which of the following conditions?
options: High oxygen level in the tissues
Low oxygen level in the tissues
High level of red blood cells
record.explanation: Answer B: Low oxygen level in the tissues. Reduced tissue oxygen tension stimulates renal erythropoietin production, which increases erythropoiesis. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK536997/; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3822280/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
